title: System Architecture Fundamentals
description: A comprehensive, first-principles exploration of how clients and servers exchange data, handle concurrency, and maintain stability under production traffic.
learningObjectives: Understand the separation of concerns between client agents and server processes
Trace requests across transport layers, network sockets, and application runtimes
Analyze bottlenecks in connection pooling, socket limits, and concurrency models
Reason about trade-offs between stateful sessions and stateless horizontal scaling
prerequisites: Basic awareness of what an IP address and port represent
